title: Sales Executive (Bristol)

Sales Executive

£35,000 - £45,000 + Bonus/Commission + Company Car

Bristol (Commutable from: Bath, Weston-super-Mare, Newport, Swindon, Gloucester, Cheltenham, Taunton, Bridgwater)
Are you a technically minded professional from the coatings, paints or industrial finishes industry looking to make the move into sales?
On offer is a home-based, field sales position covering the Bristol territory, with the backing of a leading manufacturer known for innovative decorative and protective finishes, including water-based, environmentally friendly coatings.
In this role, you will develop new business and grow existing accounts across the wood coatings market, working closely with spray shops, manufacturers and other industry customers.
You will also provide technical product advice and customer support around coatings application processes, using your existing knowledge to help customers find the right solutions while developing your commercial and sales skills.
This role would suit someone with a strong technical background in coatings, paints or spray shop operations who is looking to transition into a field-based sales role, offering the opportunity to build on existing industry knowledge while developing a career in business development.
The Role:
- Home-based field sales role covering the Bristol territory
- New business development and account management within wood coatings/finishes
- Building relationships with spray shops, manufacturers and industry customers
- Monday-Friday working week (early finish on Fridays)

The Person:
- Technical experience within wood coatings, paints, industrial finishes or a spray shop environment
- Looking to transition from a technical or application-based role into sales
- Confident communicator with strong relationship-building skills
- Self-motivated, organised and commercially minded, with a desire to learn and develop in a sales-focused role

title: Account Manager
description:
We're working with a specialist data and technology agency to find an Account Manager who enjoys both client relationships and hands-on delivery. This is not a traditional account role focused mainly on relationship management and upselling. You'll own day-to-day client relationships while also managing projects, coordinating technical and analytical teams, tracking budgets and keeping delivery on track.

What you'll be doing
As an Account Manager, you'll manage multiple client relationships and become a key point of contact across a varied portfolio. Projects can include CRM and platform work, data and insight projects, technology implementations, ongoing retainers and smaller consultancy projects.

You'll turn client requirements into clear briefs, coordinate internal teams and manage delivery from kick-off through to completion. You'll maintain project plans, timelines, risks and dependencies, oversee scope and change control, and coordinate specialist teams to make sure work is delivered on time and within agreed parameters.

Commercial management is also an important part of the role. You'll track budgets, resource and forecasting, monitor profitability and identify risks early. Project values can range from around £5k to £200k, with larger projects supported by the Pod Lead. You'll also identify opportunities and contribute to account growth, without being the primary commercial owner.

You'll work across a range of CRM, data and marketing technology platforms, supporting clients with complex data-led projects and implementations.

What experience you'll need to apply
- Experience in Account Management, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Service Delivery or a similar client-facing role.
- Experience managing projects across CRM, data, technology, SaaS, software or digital environments.
- Strong hands-on project delivery experience, including timelines, scope, risks, dependencies and change control.
- Experience managing budgets, resource allocation, forecasting or project profitability.
- Comfortable coordinating multiple clients, projects and specialist teams at the same time.
- Experience working with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience with CRM, data or marketing technology platforms would be useful.
- Commercial awareness and experience identifying opportunities or contributing to account growth.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information for different audiences.

What you'll get in return for your experience
You'll receive a competitive salary and benefits package including enhanced pension contributions, life assurance, wellness rewards, private healthcare and critical illness cover. You'll also have access to flexible hybrid working (1/2 days a week in the office) and professional development opportunities, including product and service accreditations. You'll join an organisation that places a strong emphasis on responsible business, inclusion, transparency and employee wellbeing.

What's next?
If the Account Manager opportunity sounds like a good match for your experience, apply via the button below or contact the recruitment consultant for a confidential conversation. The process starts with an initial conversation, followed by a second-stage interview and task. Reasonable adjustments can be provided for qualified candidates with disabilities where required.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Take ownership of an established Professional Indemnity insurance portfolio generating £300,000-£400,000 in annual income, with a particular focus on solicitors' PI. This Senior Account Executive opportunity offers a substantial existing book, the freedom to develop client relationships and a salary of £65,000-£90,000, alongside a car allowance and new business commission.

You'll be joining an established insurance broking business with a strong presence in the professional risks market. The emphasis is on managing, retaining and growing an existing portfolio rather than chasing new business targets, with flexible working and just one day a week in the office.

The opportunity

This is a senior client-facing position where you'll take responsibility for an established book of Professional Indemnity business, working with law firms and other professional clients.
- An established portfolio: Manage a book generating approximately £300,000-£400,000 in annual income, giving you a substantial client base from the outset.
- Specialist solicitors' PI: Work predominantly with law firms, handling Professional Indemnity placements with premiums reaching £250,000.
- Relationship-led account management: Take ownership of client relationships, providing advice on coverage, renewals and changing professional risks.
- Portfolio development: Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts, improve retention and strengthen relationships with clients and insurers.
- New business without the pressure: Winning new clients is welcomed and rewarded, but the main priority is looking after and developing the existing portfolio.
- Commercial autonomy: Take responsibility for your accounts while benefiting from the resources and insurer relationships of an established broking business.

Who would suit it?

This position would suit an experienced Professional Indemnity Account Executive or Senior Account Executive who enjoys managing complex client relationships and wants to concentrate on a quality portfolio.

You'll ideally bring:
- A strong background in Professional Indemnity insurance broking, particularly solicitors' PI.
- Experience managing a substantial portfolio of professional risks clients and handling complex renewals.
- Confidence working with larger Professional Indemnity placements, including premiums into six figures.
- Strong insurer relationships and the technical knowledge to negotiate appropriate terms and coverage.
- A commercially minded approach to client retention, account development and identifying additional opportunities.

You'll be comfortable taking ownership of an established book and developing it over the longer term, without needing to build a portfolio from scratch.

The package
- Basic salary: £65,000-£90,000, depending on experience.
- Car allowance: Approximately £6,000 per annum.
- New business commission: 20% on new business, subject to scheme terms.
- Flexible working: Just one day per week in the office.
- Annual leave: 25 days plus bank holidays.
- Pension: Company pension scheme.

Interested?

This is an opportunity for a senior Professional Indemnity specialist who wants a substantial existing portfolio, genuine responsibility for client relationships and a package that reflects their experience.

Apply through Reed or get in touch for a confidential discussion about the role and whether it could be the right next step for you.
